content.title: Dev: wire up Geist font in webapp
content.description: Implement the Geist font wire-up per the plan. (1) In frontend/src/main.tsx add `import "@fontsource-variable/geist";` as a side-effect import before ./index.css. (2) In frontend/src/index.css within the @layer base html, body block, set font-family: "Geist Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;. Do not change component contracts. Verify the build: cd packages/webapp/frontend && bun run build.

content.reason: Blocker issue mqh4gfibr3 transitioned to done

content.content:
Done. Wired up the Geist variable font in the webapp frontend:

- Added side-effect import in `frontend/src/main.tsx` before `./index.css`. Used the explicit CSS path `@fontsource-variable/geist/index.css` instead of the bare specifier in the plan — the bare form has no TS types and fails `tsc -b`; the explicit `.css` path is matched by vite/client's `declare module '*.css'` and resolves to the same stylesheet via the package's exports map. Functionally identical to the plan.
- Set `font-family: "Geist Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;` in the `@layer base` `html, body` block of `frontend/src/index.css`.

Verified with `cd packages/webapp/frontend && bun run build` (tsc -b + Vite) — passes cleanly. The Geist woff2 font subsets (latin, latin-ext, cyrillic, cyrillic-ext, vietnamese) are now self-hosted in the dist assets bundle, so no external/CDN font request is needed. No component contracts changed.

Note: no lint or test scripts are configured for the webapp package; the build is the only gate. No regressions observed.
